199 candidates were tested on chronologically separated data with costs. 4 survived validation and were opened on the untouched test period. 0 passed every gate. Staying in cash is the correct outcome until evidence supports a strategy.
Why the bot is not trading
best training config is not profitable after costs
pooled validation net return <= 0 after costs
Costs modelled at 0.6 % taker fee per side plus spread and slippage. On hourly bars gross edges were consumed by costs; daily rules produced too few trades to be statistically meaningful.

Long-only spot, no leverage, no shorting.
Signals decided at bar close; fills at next bar open with fee + half-spread + slippage per side.
Fee/spread/slippage presets are assumptions (see src/bot/costs.ts); min order from venue metadata when available.
Historical candles are indicative; executable depth was not verified.
Bonferroni alpha uses the cumulative number of candidates (all earlier registry entries + this run).
Recent history already inspected by earlier tests on the same market/timeframe (even with refreshed data) is not fresh evidence: such candidates cannot qualify without forward paper results.
Universe = coins that are large and listed today (survivorship bias). Measured in research/survivorship-study.json; qualification also requires a non-negative median on delisted markets.
Research capital normalised to $1,000; account-size feasibility evaluated separately.

A wallet is a set of keys that control coins on a blockchain. The coins stay on the blockchain; the keys prove they are yours.
This HELIX preview is free. There is no subscription, no payment and no account to create. Paper trading, markets and the research results are available to everyone who opens the app.
If paid features are ever offered, they will appear here only once a working, tested payment provider is connected.
HELIX is an independent preview built by one developer. There is no company help desk, no account to recover and no phone support.
Open an issue at github.com/CupidAmorstore/helix-preview/issues. Include your Android version, what you tapped and what you expected.
Never post your recovery phrase, vault password, private keys or API keys anywhere — no one from HELIX will ever ask for them.
Issues are read on a best-effort basis; there is no guaranteed response time during the preview.

Paper accounts and the wallet vault live only on your device. If you forget your vault password or uninstall the app, HELIX cannot restore them. Your coins stay on the blockchain and can be recovered with your written recovery phrase in any compatible wallet.
Plain-language summary of how this preview actually works. It has not yet been reviewed by a lawyer.
Nothing is sent to a HELIX server — there is none. No account, no analytics, no advertising identifiers, no tracking.

On your device HELIX stores: your paper account and order history, price alerts, your watchlist, public addresses you choose to watch, research data, and — encrypted with your vault password — your wallet recovery phrase and any API keys you enter.

To show prices and balances, the app connects directly to public services: Coinbase, CoinGecko, Kraken and Gemini (price checks in the Research Lab), Blockstream and mempool.space (Bitcoin), Etherscan (Ethereum, only with your own key), public Ethereum and Solana network endpoints (PublicNode, Cloudflare, Solana), and GitHub (research results). Like any website, these services can see your IP addr

On Android, app data is excluded from cloud backup and device transfer. Uninstalling the app, or deleting the wallet in Wallet, erases this data from the device. You can export your paper orders as CSV from Paper orders.
Because HELIX holds no personal information about you on any server, there is nothing to access or correct remotely. Questions about privacy: github.com/CupidAmorstore/helix-preview/issues.

A free preview app with live market data, paper trading with simulated money, a research tool that tests trading strategies, and a self-custody wallet whose keys stay encrypted on your device.
HELIX does not trade real money, does not hold your funds, and in this preview the wallet does not sign or send any transaction.

Nothing in HELIX is a recommendation to buy or sell. Simulated and backtested results are not earnings and do not predict future results. The trading bot reports how its tests went; it does not promise any return.
Crypto prices are very volatile; you can lose all of the money you invest. Fees matter most for small amounts: a buy and a sell at a 0.60% fee costs about 1.2% of the trade.
If you lose your recovery phrase, nobody — including HELIX — can recover your coins. Test networks (testnet, Sepolia, devnet) use coins with no value.
The app is provided as is, without warranty, and may contain errors. Market data comes from third parties and can be delayed or unavailable; the app shows when it is.
